source_title: 'Best thing is keep your mouth shut' - Mourinho on Mbappe-Mao row
source_excerpt:
Kylian Mbappe has scored 11 league goals for Jose Mourinho's Real Madrid side this season
Jose Mourinho said that "often the best thing you can do is keep your mouth shut" when asked about the angry reaction to "ill-judged" comments made by Kylian Mbappe about China's late leader Mao Zedong.
The Real Madrid head coach said that causing offence was one of the "dangers of today's world" but added that the France forward acted "very responsibly" and showed "true class" by quickly apologising.
Mbappe apologised after saying the meme that made him laugh most was one in which his face is superimposed on a "Chinese dictator" resembling Mao Zedong, who died in 1976.
Mourinho was asked about the issue in his pre-match news conference on Saturday before Sunday's La Liga game at Racing Santander.
The Portuguese manager said: "Those are the dangers of today's world where often the best thing you can do is keep your mouth shut, because there's danger in so many things you say or comment on.
"But I've also seen him act very responsibly toward a club that, at this level, is truly first-class. And as far as we're concerned, that's it. There's nothing else for us to do."
Mbappe, who is often called a "dictator" because of his huge influence in football, was discussing his nickname during an episode of French talk show The Bridge when the host asked him about memes that made him laugh.
The 27-year-old said the meme that made him "laugh the most" was "a video of a guy, I think it's a Chinese dictator..." before the show switched to footage of a meme showing Mbappe's face superimposed on an image resembling Mao.
A clip of the exchange caused a backlash on social media in China and around the world and led a number of Chinese brands to drop Mbappe.
On Tuesday, the Real forward issued a statement apologising for his "ill-judged" comments and said that "I now understand that it hurt many people in China and in Chinese communities around the world".
Mourinho, who won La Liga in 2011-12 during his first spell in charge of Real, was also asked if he was worried about being misrepresented by fake video clips of him and Mbappe created using artificial intelligence.
"I don't worry," he said. "My club is Real Madrid, and my player is Kylian Mbappe.
"Both Real Madrid and Kylian Mbappe have shown the class to react immediately, and I feel very well represented by both of them."

## जोस مورिन्हो ने काइलियन एम्बाप्पे का किया बचाव

रियल मैड्रिड के मुख्य कोच जोस مورिन्हो ने हाल ही में काइलियन एम्बाप्पे द्वारा चीन के दिवंगत नेता माओ त्से-तुंग पर की गई टिप्पणी और उसके बाद उपजे विवाद पर अपनी बात रखी है। مورिन्हो का कहना है कि आज की दुनिया में कई बार सबसे अच्छा काम यही होता है कि आप अपना मुंह बंद रखें, क्योंकि आपके बयानों और टिप्पणियों में कई तरह के जोखिम जुड़े होते हैं।

## विवाद की पृष्ठभूमि

यह पूरा विवाद तब शुरू हुआ जब फ्रांसीसी टॉक शो 'द ब्रिज' के दौरान एम्बाप्पे से उन मीम्स के बारे में पूछा गया जिन पर उन्हें सबसे ज्यादा हंसी आती है। इस बातचीत के दौरान एक ऐसा वीडियो दिखाया गया जिसमें एम्बाप्पे के चेहरे को माओ त्से-तुंग से मिलते-जुलते एक चीनी नेता के ऊपर सुपरइम्पोज किया गया था। इस टिप्पणी के बाद सोशल मीडिया पर चीन और दुनिया भर में कड़ी प्रतिक्रिया देखने को मिली, जिसके चलते कई चीनी ब्रांड्स ने एम्बाप्पे के साथ अपने संबंध समाप्त कर दिए।

## एम्बाप्पे की माफी और مورिन्हो का बयान

रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, इस तीखी प्रतिक्रिया के बाद एम्बाप्पे ने अपने बयानों के लिए सार्वजनिक रूप से माफी मांगते हुए कहा कि वह अब समझ चुके हैं कि इससे चीन और दुनिया भर के चीनी समुदायों के कई लोगों को ठेस पहुंची है।

शनिवार को रेसिंग सेंटेंडर के खिलाफ होने वाले ला लीगा मैच से पहले प्रेस कॉन्फ्रेंस में बात करते हुए, مورिन्हो ने इस स्थिति पर प्रकाश डाला:

* **जिम्मेदार रवैया:** مورिन्हो ने कहा कि एम्बाप्पे ने बहुत जिम्मेदारी से काम किया और अपनी त्वरित माफी के जरिए 'सच्ची क्लास' का परिचय दिया।
* **क्लब का रुख:** उन्होंने कहा कि इस स्तर पर क्लब के प्रति खिलाड़ी का यह रवैया प्रथम श्रेणी का है और उनके पक्ष में अब इस मामले पर करने के लिए कुछ और शेष नहीं है।
* **एआई और फर्जी वीडियो पर चिंता:** जब مورिन्हो से पूछा गया कि क्या उन्हें आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस द्वारा बनाए गए उनके और एम्बाप्पे के फर्जी वीडियो से डर है, तो उन्होंने स्पष्ट किया कि उन्हें इस बात की कोई चिंता नहीं है।

## सत्यापन और जानकारी कैसे प्राप्त करें

* इस घटना की मूल कवरेज और बर्ड्स-आई व्यू के लिए बीबीसी स्पोर्ट जैसे आधिकारिक खेल समाचार पोर्टल्स की रिपोर्ट देख सकते हैं।
* संबंधित खिलाड़ियों और क्लबों के आधिकारिक सोशल मीडिया हैंडल और प्रेस विज्ञप्तियों का संदर्भ लें।
* खेल जगत की प्रामाणिक पॉडकास्ट और विश्लेषणात्मक रिपोर्टों के माध्यम से सत्यापित विवरण प्राप्त करें।

en_body:
## Mourinho Addresses the Controversy

Real Madrid head coach Jose Mourinho has defended forward Kylian Mbappe, stating that the player acted "very responsibly" by issuing a swift apology for comments regarding China's late leader Mao Zedong. Speaking at a pre-match news conference ahead of Sunday's La Liga fixture against Racing Santander, Mourinho remarked on the modern media landscape, noting that "often the best thing you can do is keep your mouth shut" due to the numerous risks associated with public commentary.

The controversy began after Mbappe appeared on the French talk show *The Bridge*. During the program, the 27-year-old discussed his football nickname—which references his significant influence within the sport—and was asked by the host about memes that made him laugh. Mbappe mentioned a video featuring a "Chinese dictator," after which the show displayed a meme superimposing the player's face onto an image resembling Mao Zedong.

## Fallout and Apology

* **Social Media Backlash:** The broadcast sparked widespread criticism online in China and internationally.
* **Commercial Impact:** Several Chinese brands reportedly dropped Mbappe following the incident.
* **Public Apology:** On Tuesday, the Real Madrid forward released a statement describing his remarks as "ill-judged" and acknowledging that his comments had caused hurt in China and among Chinese communities globally.

Mourinho praised the immediate response from both the player and the club, stating that Mbappe demonstrated "true class" through his apology. The manager also addressed questions regarding the potential misuse of artificial intelligence to generate fake videos, affirming that he remains unconcerned and feels well-represented by the club and his player.

## Practical Implications and Verification

Observers note that high-profile athletes face intense global scrutiny across digital platforms, where spontaneous remarks on talk shows can quickly generate international repercussions. 

Readers seeking to verify the details of this announcement can consult official club communications from Real Madrid, statements released directly through Kylian Mbappe's verified social media channels, or coverage from major sports journalism networks reporting on La Liga.
